author: reek
body: Recognizable American skylines. Each city draws a procedural backdrop for depth, then its signature landmark(s) in front at a smaller depth. Every triangle lists the left base vertex, then the right base, then the apex (for an apex-up shape), giving the negative signed area the rasterizer keeps; apex-down shapes list the right base first.

author: reek
body: The 12th-Man sub-line, Seattle only. HOME OF THE REIGNING SUPERBOWL CHAMPION SEAHAWKS! in action green, drawn at half the city-name size on its own row. Column indices leave a blank slot for each word break.

author: reek
body: md is modulo for wrapping the ever-increasing spawn cursor into a slot.

author: reek
body: Photoreal draw: soft round embers that cool from white-hot to their ember color to a dim red as they age, blended additively with a radial falloff and bloom.

author: reek
body: Mode 1: the photoreal take. Same skyline and burst physics, but sparks are soft luminous embers (no HUD chrome), letting the bloom and grade carry a long-exposure, photographic look.

author: reek
body: GPU port I/O carries the Gpu.Compute capability effect, so each `gpu-out` call is an act-bind. The pure launch/update/draw run in a let-in tail; the flush and the returned cursor thread through flush-ret. The keyboard read is the common `poll-key` (UI KeyInput): a pure `Integer` that consumes the IRQ1 key cell and returns a translated, shift/caps-cased key code, so it binds with `let`, not an act-bind.
